name: atk
description: AI Team Kit - 20 skills covering the software delivery lifecycle of a company project team: project profile setup, per-team skill overrides, requirement intake, catching up on work in flight, estimation, technical design, reference specs for API, schema and feature, task breakdown, conventions, implementation planning, implementation, bug fixing, code review, QA, runtime verification, release, incident response, retrospective, onboarding, and handover

interface.shortDescription: Run the delivery lifecycle of a project team: intake, estimate, design, breakdown, plan, implement, fix, review, QA, verify, release, incident, retro
interface.longDescription: AI Team Kit turns the habits of a company project team into 20 repeatable skills. It records what this project actually is so the rest of the kit stops guessing, clarifies a stakeholder request into user stories with acceptance criteria, brings someone up to speed on work they did not help start, estimates and fills a sprint against real capacity, writes the technical design document and the ADR behind it, keeps the reference documents that say what the API, the schema and each feature do today, breaks an epic into owned tasks, records the team coding conventions, plans a piece of work into phases that each end in something reviewable, writes the code against those conventions, proves the cause of a defect before changing a line, reviews a pull request, plans and writes the test cases, exercises the running system to confirm the feature works on real data, ships the release with a checklist and a rollback path, runs an incident to a blameless postmortem, holds a retrospective with follow-up actions that have owners, onboards a new member, and hands work over when a member or a phase changes. Every artifact is Markdown first, so it works whether the team tracks work in GitHub Issues, Jira, Backlog, or Redmine.
defaultPrompt: Set up atk in this project so the skills know our commands and layers.
Turn this customer request into user stories with acceptance criteria.
Plan this ticket into phases, then implement it against our conventions.
Prove the cause of this bug before changing anything.
Review this pull request against our team conventions.
